description: Get a login/verification code or magic/confirmation link from email. Use it right after triggering a signup, login or "confirm your email" step that emails a code or link to one of your inboxes. Waits up to timeout_seconds for it to arrive and returns the NEWEST matching message's code/link with a confidence score. Codes from mail whose sender failed authentication (possibly spoofed) are skipped unless include_unauthenticated is true. Tip: record the time before triggering the email and pass it as "since".

from.description: Sender: an address (exactly) or a domain (and its subdomains), e.g. "noreply@github.com" or "github.com". Never matches the display name: a name can say anything.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address.

include_unauthenticated.description: Also return a code or link from mail whose sender failed authentication (DMARC, or SPF without aligned DKIM): it may come from a spoofer. Only when you just requested that code and nothing else arrived.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only mail created after it counts. Default: the moment this call starts, so mail that ALREADY arrived is ignored. Pass a time from just before you triggered the email to avoid missing it.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for mail to arrive, 1-60 seconds (default 30).

name: get_verification_code
title: Get verification code
